title: antinisa involucrata
intro: Antinisa involucrata, commonly known as "Tulsi" or "Holy Basil", is a plant species in the mint family known for its sacred and medicinal properties. It offers various health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving respiratory health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Antinisa involucrata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and adaptogenic properties, which help in protecting against oxidative stress and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Antinisa involucrata include ursolic acid, oleanolic acid, and eugenol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
